_comment: Single source of truth for the Hugging Face repos this pipeline pulls. scripts/check_hf.py iterates `models`; tests/test_models_manifest.py asserts modal_app.py has not drifted from it. models.note: faster-whisper resolves the alias 'large-v3' to this repo internally; modal_app.py only names the alias
